Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. RATE TO BE QUOTTED BY BIDDERS: - Bidders have to quote their rate for 20 trips without GST & Financi al Ranking (determination of L-1 bidder) shall be based on the quoted rate excluding GST. After getting L-1 Bidder, applicable GST Rate will be confirmed from the L-1 Bidder and recorded in SO pla cement minutes. Total Contract Value reflected on GeM SO will be excluding GST even though GeM contra ct shows it as inclusive of all duties and taxes and GST shall be paid by the Bidder as applicable as recorde d in SO placement minutes and in accordance with applicable GST provisions. 2. L-1 EVALUATION: L-1 will be decided on the basis of rate quote by the Firm for 20Trips which will be excluding of GST. 3. Bidder must submit ANNEXURE-‘A’ duly signed and stamped. (Annexure ‘A’ is attached at the end of Ten der Document which is uploaded in bid under heading “ Scope of Work”. 4. PAYMENT TERMS: Payment terms will be as per service level agreement of “GOOD TRANSPORT SERVICE- PER TRIP BASED SE RVICE” and to be made within 30 days after completion of work & receipt of bill / requisite documents alon g with Service Entry Sheet generated by User Section in SAP (QAP Section). 5. Please refer attached bid documents such as TENDER DOCUMENT, GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS A S ANNEXURE ‘A’, SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT of “GOOD TRANSPORT SERVICE- PER TRIP BASED SERVICE” and submit your offer accordingly with all supporting documents including duly signed & stamped complia nce statement in compliance towards all bid clause. (Compliance statement is attached from page no. 28 to 29 of tender document). 6. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE: NOT APPLICABLE 7. MSE/START UP EXEMPTION W.R.T. TURNOVER AND EXPERIENCE WILL NOT BE APPLICABLE CONSIDERIN G THAT INSTANT CASE NECESSITATES SAFETY OF DEFENCE CATEGORY STORES. ALSO, SERVICE BEING OF CRITICAL NATURE HENCE SUPPLY HAS TO BE ENSURED FROM REPUTED FIRMS HAVING TECHNICAL EXPERI ENCE/ EXPERTISE AND SUFFICIENT FINANCIAL CAPABILITY. 8. In the column of “ DOCUMENT REQUIRED FROM SELLER” , there is mentioned that “ In case any bidder i s seeking exemption from experience/ turnover criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility fo r exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by buyer”. However, in instant case, MSE/START UP exempti on w.r.t. turnover and experience will not be applicable as mentioned at point 7 above. 9. Firm has to submit EMD of Rs. 1,84,680/-. In order to avail EMD exemption, firm has to submit relevant documents as per GeM GTC & MIL SPM 2023. 10. DELIVERY PERIOD : 1 YEAR FROM SERVICE START DATE AS PER GEM CONTRACT. 11. If IP address of the bidder matches with IP address of the other participated bidder in the instant Bid, of fers of firm with common IP address may be rejected straightaway in suspect of cartel formation. 12. Vendor must submit & upload Udyam registration certificate with latest classification year 2025-26 to avail/gain MSE benefits. 13. Make in India compliance (Local Content Declaration as per Make In India Clause mentioning the perce ntage of local content and location where the local content addition has been made ) . 14. Firm has to submit undertaking mentioning that firm has not been banned or de-listed by any Central/

State Govt, PSU etc. Also, firm are not under liquidation/solvency, court receivership or similar proceedings . confirming that the firm have not been indicted for any criminal, fraudulent or anti-competition activity a nd not under any cartel formation with any of participated bidders and firm will quote competitive rate in f uture tenders. 15. Eligibility Criteria: (i) firm should have successfully executed at least one contract for transportation of defence store with an y one of the Central Govt./ State Govt./ PSU/ Public Listed Company. Firms should submit copies of supply orders along with job completion certificate executed during the last 7 years from the date of publication of bid in support of these criteria. (ii) Average annual financial turn over during last 03 years i.e. during year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 sh ould be “18 Lakh” . Firm should submit relevant documents in its support for compliance of this criteria. T urnover certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant is the most preferred documents. Offer of the fir m having average annual financial turnover less than 18 Lakh will be rejected at Technical Evaluation stag e. (iii) Firm must submit complete set of GST registration certificate along with bid documents giving details o f managing / whole time directors and key managing Persons. (iv) Firm shall comply to the specification of hiring of private trailer truck for shifting of Pinaka Launcher fro m ARDE Pune to PFFR Pokharan and back as Annexure “A”. 16. Bid to RA post Technical evaluation: - Applicable with eliminate only H-1 Bidder. 17. DETENTION CHARGES applicable as per Annexure “A”. 18. Penalties and Fine :- As per GeM Service Level Agreement. .
